subject: Consumption bands pricing — proposed breakpoint model
messages:
From: Paul Klein <paul.klein@fastcommerce.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 2026-03-02 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing for heavy monthly consumption

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo last week. FastCommerce is evaluating a hosted-inference setup for our search and recommendations flows. Traffic is spiky but our expected monthly total is roughly 1.2 billion tokens, with peak qps around 350.

Before we proceed to a pilot, procurement needs a clear view of baseline unit pricing and how discounts scale as usage grows. Specifically:
- A sample monthly rate card with breakpoints or bands
- Any requirements for committed minimums or monthly minimum spend
- Billing cadence and invoicing terms for enterprise customers

Can you share a simple breakpoints proposal and any contract templates we should expect?

Paul
Paul Klein
Director of Platform Engineering
FastCommerce
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
To: Paul Klein <paul.klein@fastcommerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 2026-03-03 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for heavy monthly consumption

Hi Paul,

Appreciate the clear specs — that helps a lot. Looping in Rishi (account lead) and Ben (pricing) so we can propose a concise breakpoints model and cover commercial terms. High level plan:

1) Ben will propose 3 consumption bands with example unit prices and suggested minimums.
2) We will attach a sample ratecard and a redline-friendly MA template for procurement.
3) If that looks good, we can schedule a 30-minute scoping call to align SLA/burst behavior.

Ben and Rishi, can you take this on and aim to send a first pass by end of day Wednesday?

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Paul Klein <paul.klein@fastcommerce.com>
Date: Wed, 2026-03-04 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption bands pricing — proposed breakpoint model

Paul, Jasmine, Rishi,

Attached is a first-pass consumption breakpoint proposal redwood_consumption_breakpoints_v1.xlsx. Summary below. I kept the model simple to make decisioning easier for procurement.

Proposed banded model (hosted API, per 1k tokens):
- Band A 0 - 100M tokens: $0.013 per 1k tokens (baseline pay-as-you-go)
- Band B 100M - 500M tokens: $0.009 per 1k tokens
- Band C >500M tokens: $0.006 per 1k tokens

Suggested commercial guardrails:
- Optional monthly committed spend to lock Band C pricing: $30k/mo minimum for 12-month term
- Non-committed customers billed monthly, prices applied month-to-month based on consumption tiers
- Bursting above committed throughput allowed with overage at Band A rate unless a separate burst agreement is in place

Open items for procurement:
- Whether FastCommerce needs an invoice-based monthly billing vs card on file
- VAT or reverse charge considerations for your region

Next steps: can you confirm which pricing band you expect to land in based on your forecast? We can then map to a short-term pilot option and a committed program.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Pricing Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_consumption_breakpoints_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Paul Klein <paul.klein@fastcommerce.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@fastcommerce.com
Date: Thu, 2026-03-05 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption bands pricing — proposed breakpoint model

Thanks Ben — helpful and clear. A few follow-ups from procurement and engineering:

1) Breakpoints: Based on our internal forecast, we expect month 1 to be ~120M tokens, ramping to 600M by month 4. We would ask to make the Band B threshold start at 75M rather than 100M so that month 1 pricing reflects a mid-tier discount.

2) Commit minimum: The $30k/mo for Band C seems fair, but procurement would prefer a stepped commit option for the first 3 months (for example 50% of the 12mo minimum in months 1-3, then full thereafter).

3) Billing: procurement prefers invoice monthly net 30. Please indicate whether we can receive monthly invoices and whether DocuSign is your preferred signature flow.

If you can send an updated table reflecting the breakpoint shift and a sample invoice cadence/terms, procurement can fast-track.

Paul
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
To: procurement@fastcommerce.com, Paul Klein <paul.klein@fastcommerce.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 2026-03-08 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption bands pricing — proposed breakpoint model

Hi Paul,

Quick note from legal on commercial terms:
- We can support invoice monthly net 30 with standard enterprise billing.
- For stepped commits we will propose a 3-month ramp clause in the MA that defines the initial % of committed spend and how make-whole amounts are calculated if future commits are not met.
- Please confirm your procurement contact for contract delivery; we will send a redline-friendly MA and a sample invoice template.

Copying Jasmine and Ben for alignment on pricing adjustments.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: example_ma_template.pdf (sample master agreement)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
To: Paul Klein <paul.klein@fastcommerce.com>, procurement@fastcommerce.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 2026-03-10 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consumption bands pricing — proposed breakpoint model

Paul — thanks for the quick feedback. Summary and next steps: 

- Action: Ben will update the spreadsheet to move Band B start to 75M and add a 3-month stepped commit row. Expect updated file by EOD Wednesday.
- Action: Lauren will draft the stepped commit clause and attach the MA for procurement review.
- Billing: We support monthly invoicing net 30 and will include a sample invoice template.
- Scheduling: I booked a 30-minute call for Thursday Mar 12 at 10:00 AM PT to review the adjusted rate card and finalize pilot terms. Calendar invite sent separately.

Paul, if procurement can share the contact name at procurement@fastcommerce.com we will send the MA and invoice sample to them directly.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting the pilot on the road.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
